newsitem.title: BELGIUM: EU confirms eight green rates to devalue on Friday.
newsitem.headline: EU confirms eight green rates to devalue on Friday.

text.p: The green rates of the Belgian franc, German mark, Dutch Guilder, Danish crown, French franc, Spanish peseta, Portuguese escudo and Austrian schilling will be devalued on Friday, the European Commission confirmed.

The green Belgian franc will devalue to 40.7357 per Ecu from the current rate of 40.4285, the green mark will devalue to 1.97407 from 1.95929 and the green guilder will devalue to 2.22212 per ecu from 2.20397.
The green Danish crown will devalue to 7.51757 from 7.49997, while the green French franc will devalue to 6.65716 from 6.61023.
The green Spanish peseta will devalue to 166.718 from 165.571 and green Portuguese escudo will devalue to 199.234 from 198.202.
And the green Austrian schilling will devalue to 13.8905 From 13.7910.
The devaluations were forecast earlier on Thursday by the UK's Home-Grown Cereals Authority.
Green rates are used by the European Union to convert Ecus into the currencies of its member states in its Common Agricultural Policy.
